task_metadata.research_topic: protein-ligand binding affinity prediction from 3D structures
task_metadata.research_question: Design a GNN architecture that effectively models protein-ligand interactions to predict binding affinity (-logKd/Ki) from 3D structural data.
notes: Baselines and tests are mapped to the PDBbind/CASF literature and related 3D affinity-prediction papers.

tests.label: PDBbind2013
tests.notes: Uses the PDBbind 2013 release and the CASF-2013 benchmark papers.

tests.label: PDBbind2016
tests.notes: The 2016 core set aligns with the CASF-2016 update and the PDBbind database family.

tests.label: PDBbind2019
tests.notes: Temporal holdout derived from the PDBbind release stream; no single canonical benchmark paper was found in the search results.

baselines.name: ehign
baselines.notes: Explainable heterogeneous interaction GNN used as the task's primary baseline.

baselines.name: gign
baselines.notes: Geometric interaction GNN baseline for 3D protein-ligand affinity prediction.

baselines.name: schnet
baselines.notes: General atomistic continuous-filter convolution baseline adapted to the PLA graph setting.

baselines.name: egnn
baselines.notes: E(n)-equivariant message-passing baseline for geometry-aware prediction.
